description: Ministry of Education - Order to amend The Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Principals' Service published in the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1885/31 of 22.10.2014
reasoning: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Principals' Service, which deals specifically with public service recruitment, promotions, seniority placement, salary entitlements, and qualification requirements for principals. As it is issued by the Public Service Commission and focuses on public sector service conditions and administrative procedures, it falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
